findings.evidence: AddCircle.lean:115 `private def planeDeriv (p) := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod (fderiv ℝ L p)`; :132 `LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo (planeDeriv ...)`; :182 `private theorem contDiff_invLift : ContDiff ℝ n (invLift ...)`. The PR's `hΦ`, `hinj'` and `ofInjectiveEndo` steps have the same shape.
findings.fix: Keep one shared construction. In AddCircle.lean, define `invLift q := invFun (fun x ↦ L (q.1, x)) q.2` and prove `contDiff_invLift` as `contDiffOn_univ.1 (by simpa using hL.contDiffOn.parametric_invFun isOpen_univ (by simpa using hn) (fun s _ ↦ bijective slice via exists_lift_inverse) (fun s _ x ↦ injectivity from hpos))`. Then delete `planeDeriv`, `injective_planeDeriv`, `planeDerivEquiv`, `coe_planeDerivEquiv`, `hasStrictFDerivAt_plane` and `planeHomeomorph`, and derive the inverse laws from `leftInverse_invFun`/`rightInverse_invFun`.
findings.issue: `ContDiffOn.parametric_invFun` (graph map `(p, x) ↦ (p, g (p, x))`, block-triangular injective derivative, `LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo`, smooth inverse) repeats the private chain `planeDeriv`, `injective_planeDeriv`, `planeDerivEquiv`, `coe_planeDerivEquiv`, `hasStrictFDerivAt_plane`, `planeHomeomorph`, `contDiff_invLift` in TauCeti/Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Diffeotopy/AddCircle.lean:114-185. summary: The new general lemma `ContDiffOn.parametric_invFun` repeats the private graph-map inverse construction in `Diffeotopy/AddCircle.lean` without either reusing the other, and two smaller steps re-prove existing TauCeti lemmas about lift interpolation.
